title: 第13章 丹成收徒第14章 玄阳大师登门相助
content_zh:
看到苏尘开始炼丹，玄阳大师也屏息凝神，内心却充满了激动。
他对苏尘还是十分期待的。
他炼制的九阳回春丹虽然是废丹，但最后做了一些处理，一般人根本看不出来。
而且一般人也不可能对控火之法和天地奇火，有着如此细致的了解，除了王都的那些炼丹大师，恐怕听都没听过。
所以在他看来，苏尘绝对是一位来历非同寻常的丹道高手。
虽然苏尘说是自学，但他可以肯定，对方背后有一位丹道宗师，甚至可能是丹圣！
一想到这里，玄阳大师的内心便无比火热。
但紧跟着，他就傻眼了。
苏尘来到丹鼎之前，左手轻轻一划，便将所有的珍材一股脑儿的扔进了丹炉之中。
“什么？！”
玄阳大师整个人都懵了。
那些珍材的品级极高，纵使他千方百计引来了地脉之火，也无法完全炼化药力，所以才炼出废丹。
莫说是他，就算是那些名动天下的丹道宗师，也都是小心翼翼的逐个炼化，以激发其中的药力和能量才行。
炼丹是个高精密的细致活，像苏尘这样大刀阔斧的做法，古往今来闻所未闻。
“难道他不会炼丹？”
玄阳大师心中当即咯噔了一下。
九阳回春丹的炼制材料本就无比罕见，用一份可就少一份啊。
然而就在此时，苏尘的右手突然打出道道法印，瞬间就掌控了狂暴的地脉之火操，火焰时红时青时白，变化极快，让人眼花缭乱。
嗖嗖嗖嗖……
一股股炽烈的地脉之火升腾而起，如细小的火龙，分别盘绕在那些珍材之上，开始了疯狂的煅烧。

片刻后，一缕缕药香就开始逸散出来。
“这……”
玄阳大师的眼珠子差点都瞪了出来。
那些珍材并没有彼此冲突而报废，反而各自激发出纯粹的药力和能量。
外行看热闹，内行看门道。
玄阳大师作为大楚王国赫赫有名的炼丹师，自幼侵淫丹道，更是曾蒙受一位丹道宗师的指点。
虽然他刚才对苏尘表现的十分谦恭和热情，但那只是笼络人心的手段，内心深处依旧是极为高傲自负的。
可是跟此刻的苏尘一比，他也不得不承认，对方的手法远要比他老练、纯熟，那行云流水般的动作似乎还蕴含着一缕缕神秘的道韵。
好像是在丹道一途浸淫了几百几千年的老怪物一样。
如此惊人的手法，别说是他，就连曾指点他的那位丹道宗师也望尘莫及。
轰！
苏尘的手上不断冒闪着火光，似有大道符文乍现，流露出一股股神秘的力量，完美的操控着地脉之火，时而狂暴，时而柔和……
远远超过了地脉之火的本身力量。
这种对于火焰的精细掌控，已然达到了化腐朽为神奇的地步。
每一个细小的动作都极尽完美，散发出只有丹师才能感应到的神秘韵律。
他们这些炼丹师，只是按照前人的经验，按照丹方的规定和描述，什么时候放什么材料，什么时候用什么温度，机械而又生硬。
而苏尘炼丹，却是一门艺术。
这完全打破了玄阳大师的认知，明明看起来像是胡搞乱搞，却有一种神秘的道韵流转，暗合天地至理，似乎炼丹本该是这个样子的。
“他果然掌握控火之法！
而且这等法门，也太高深莫测了！”

玄阳大师几乎无法呼吸了，瞪着充血的双眼，想要毫无错漏的记录下每一个瞬间。
content_en:
Seeing Su Chen starting to refine the elixir, Master Xuanyang held his breath and concentrated, but his heart was full of excitement.
He was still looking forward to Su Chen.
Although the Nine-Yang Rejuvenation Pill he refined was a waste pill, it had some processing done at the end that ordinary people couldn't tell.
Moreover, it is impossible for ordinary people to have such a detailed understanding of the method of controlling fire and the strange fires of heaven and earth. Except for those alchemy masters in the royal capital, I am afraid they have never heard of it.
Therefore, in his opinion, Su Chen was definitely an alchemy master with extraordinary origins.
Although Su Chen said he was self-taught, he was certain that there was an alchemy master behind the other party, maybe even an alchemy sage!
When he thought of this, Master Xuanyang's heart became extremely hot.
But then, he was dumbfounded.
When Su Chen came to the alchemy cauldron, he flicked his left hand and threw all the precious materials into the alchemy cauldron.
"What?!"
Master Xuanyang was completely stunned.
Those precious materials were of extremely high grade. Even if he tried every means to attract the fire of the earth veins, he could not completely refine the medicinal power, so he refined the waste elixir.
Not to mention him, even those world-famous alchemy masters carefully refined them one by one to stimulate the medicinal power and energy in them.
Alchemy is a high-precision and meticulous work. Su Chen's drastic approach has never been heard of in ancient times.
"Doesn't he know how to make elixirs?"
Master Xuanyang's heart suddenly thumped.
The materials for refining the Nine Yang Rejuvenation Pill are extremely rare, so if you use one part, you will lose one part.
However, at this moment, Su Chen's right hand suddenly shot out a series of seals, and he instantly controlled the violent Earth Vein Fire Exercise. The flames alternated between red, green, and white, changing extremely quickly and dazzlingly.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh whoosh...
Fierce terrestrial fires rose up, like tiny fire dragons, coiled around the precious materials and began to simmer crazily.
After a while, wisps of medicinal fragrance began to escape.
"This..."
Master Xuanyang's eyes almost popped out.
Those precious materials did not conflict with each other and become scrapped. Instead, they each stimulated pure medicinal power and energy.
A layman looks at the excitement, an expert looks at the door.
As a famous alchemist in the Dachu Kingdom, Master Xuanyang had been involved in alchemy since he was a child, and he was even taught by an alchemy master.
Although he had shown great humility and enthusiasm to Su Chen just now, it was just a way to win over people's hearts, and he was still extremely arrogant deep down.
But compared with Su Chen at this moment, he had to admit that the other party's techniques were far more sophisticated and proficient than his, and his flowing movements seemed to contain wisps of mysterious Taoist charm.
It seems like an old monster that has been immersed in the alchemy path for hundreds of thousands of years.
Such an astonishing technique was beyond the reach of even the alchemy master who had taught him, not to mention him.
boom!
Su Chen's hands were constantly flashing with fire, as if the runes of the Great Dao suddenly appeared, revealing a mysterious power, perfectly controlling the fire of the earth's veins, sometimes violently, sometimes softly...
It far exceeds the power of the earth's fire itself.
This kind of fine control of flames has reached the point where it can turn decay into magic.
Every tiny movement is perfect, exuding a mysterious rhythm that only an alchemist can sense.
They, the alchemists, just follow the experience of their predecessors and the regulations and descriptions of the elixir, when to put what materials, when to use what temperature, which is mechanical and stiff.
But Su Chen's alchemy is an art.
This completely broke Master Xuanyang's cognition. It looked like he was messing around, but there was a mysterious Tao rhythm that coincided with the principles of heaven and earth. It seemed that alchemy should be like this.
"He really knows how to control fire!
Moreover, this kind of method is too profound and unpredictable! "
Master Xuanyang could hardly breathe, staring with bloodshot eyes, trying to record every moment without any mistakes.
